LLM auditresponse for .SRCINFO:


<security_assessment>
<decision>SAFE</decision>
<details>
The .SRCINFO file is a standard metadata file for an AUR binary package (lyrune-bin). All four source URLs point to the project's own upstream repository at github.com/amtoaer/lyrune, fetched over HTTPS. The two asset sources (desktop file and SVG icon) come from a pinned tag (v1.5.0) on raw.githubusercontent.com, and the prebuilt binary tarballs come from the corresponding GitHub release tag. Valid SHA256 checksums are provided for every source — none are set to SKIP. The dependencies, provides, conflicts, and options fields are all consistent with ordinary Arch packaging practices for a prebuilt binary application. There is no evidence of obfuscated code, unexpected file operations, data exfiltration, or execution of attacker-controlled content.
</details>

LLM auditresponse for PKGBUILD:
<security_assessment>
<decision>SAFE</decision>
<details>
The PKGBUILD is a standard AUR package for distributing prebuilt binaries. It downloads the application binary from the official GitHub releases page (matching the upstream project) and associated desktop/icon files from the repository. The package() function performs typical installation steps: placing the binary in /usr/bin, desktop file in /usr/share/applications, icon in /usr/share/icons, and documentation/license files in standard locations. No suspicious network requests, obfuscated code, dangerous commands (like eval, curl, or wget), or unexpected file operations are present. The checksums are provided and verified. This follows conventional practices for binary packages in the AUR.
</details>
